Longevity Life Academy is delighted to invite you to The Longevity Masterclass Event of the Year.

Learn to age slower with Julie Gibson Clark, the second slowest aging person on Earth.

Tonight, Tuesday, October 27, 7:00 PM Eastern Time. Live on Zoom.
Reserve your seat: https://www.longevitylifeacademy.com/julie-masterclass

Julie is 56, a single mom and a recruiter from Phoenix. Epigenetic testing shows she ages 6.5 years per decade, one of the slowest rates ever recorded, and she got there without a private lab, a medical team or a fortune. In her masterclass she reveals her full longevity protocol and the daily routine behind it.

In her masterclass we'll cover:
• How biological aging is measured, and what actually moves the number
• Her daily routine, hour by hour: sleep, food, movement and stress
• How to test before you buy, so you only spend on what works for you

The masterclass starts at $49 for the full 60-minute live session. VIP access adds a private 30-minute Q&A with Julie.

Live seats are limited.
Reserve your seat: https://www.longevitylifeacademy.com/julie-masterclass
